title: Battle of Ain Dara
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ain Dara", at revision 1370431170, opens: "The Battle of Ain Dara occurred in the village of Ain Dara, in Mount Lebanon in 1711, between the Qaysi and Yamani, two rival tribo-political factions." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2887920, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle between the Qaysi and Yamani tribo-political factions (1711)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
